comment: What each button means on every client. Clients map their platform's key codes to these actions.

confirm.controller: The right-hand confirm button (A on Xbox, Cross on PlayStation, A on Nintendo)

back.controller: B on Xbox, Circle on PlayStation, B on Nintendo

playPause.controller: X on Xbox, Square on PlayStation, Y on Nintendo

rules: Focus is always visible and starts on the most likely choice.
Back goes up one level. It only leaves the app from the top level.
Returning to a screen puts focus back where it was.
In the player, up or down shows the controls, and left or right seeks while they are hidden.
